label: Johor Bahru
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels across Johor Bahru, Malaysia's southern gateway city on the causeway to Singapore.
intro: Johor Bahru's hotels in this directory sit in and around the city center of Malaysia's southern gateway, immediately across the causeway from Singapore -- a base for cross-border business, shopping malls, and family attractions such as Legoland Malaysia in nearby Iskandar Puteri. Properties range from established city hotels to newer select-service stays, all within a short drive of the CIQ checkpoints and roughly 30-40 minutes from Senai International Airport (JHB).
